{
 "cwd": "/workspace",
 "query": "MASTER PROMPT – Create a premium static portfolio/event website for “Wildleaf Press Gathering 2026”, a nature-inspired publishing event and editorial portfolio. The website should feel like Apple’s clean product pages: lots of breathing room, huge elegant typography, soft gradients, polished cards, smooth section transitions, minimal navigation, premium editorial layout. This is a STATIC FRONT-END ONLY site, no backend, no database, no login, no real API, no payment, no external services. Use mock/static/sample content and placeholder images if needed. Goal: showcase a boutique publishing studio + their annual nature writing event. Visual Style: nature, calm, modern, premium, editorial. Colors: mist white #F7F8F5, deep forest #123226, moss green #6F8F5A, warm paper #EFE7D4, ink black #111111, soft sky #DDEAE7. Use Apple-like composition: centered hero, large headline, clean sticky nav, crisp product-style sections, subtle glass panels, rounded cards, soft shadows, high-quality spacing, smooth hover states. Website Type: static portfolio-site + event landing page for publishing domain. Main brand: Wildleaf Press. Event: Wildleaf Press Gathering 2026. Tagline: “Where Nature Writing Becomes Living Literature.” Header: small logo wordmark Wildleaf Press, nav links: Gathering, Portfolio, Speakers, Schedule, Journal, Chatbot, Tickets Info. CTA button: “View Event Program”. Hero Section: full-screen-ish elegant Apple-style hero with large headline: “A Publishing Gathering Rooted in the Living World.” Subtitle: “Three days of essays, field notes, poetry, bookmaking, and conversations for writers who listen to forests, rivers, and seasons.” Primary CTA: “Explore the Gathering”. Secondary CTA: “See Editorial Portfolio”. Add soft abstract nature background, maybe blurred leaf silhouettes, paper texture, light green gradient blob, no heavy clutter. Include small badge: “May 22–24, 2026 • Static Demo Program”. Hero visual: premium floating editorial cards: Book Cover Mockup, Field Notes Issue, Speaker Quote, Schedule Card. About Section: explain Wildleaf Press as an independent publishing studio focused on environmental essays, poetry chapbooks, field journals, and slow editorial craft. Make it feel like a portfolio, not just event page. Add 3 cards: Editorial Direction, Print Design, Nature Essays. Event Overview Section: Apple-style split layout with sticky image/card on one side and text panels on other. Include details: location can be fictional “Mossbank Conservatory & Reading Hall”, theme “The Language of Wild Places”, audience “authors, editors, illustrators, small press founders, librarians, readers”. IMPORTANT: all data is static sample content. Portfolio Section: showcase 6 publishing projects with cards. Titles: “Riverlight Essays Vol. 04”, “The Alpine Field Notebook”, “Moss & Margin”, “Birdsong Chapbook Series”, “Canopy Review”, “Tidepool Letters”. Each card needs category, year, short description, mock metrics like pages / format / editorial focus. Use beautiful editorial cover placeholders with gradients/nature patterns. Featured Program Section: schedule for 3 days with tabs or static buttons (can be non-functional or simple front-end state only, no backend). Day 1: Arrival + keynote + evening reading. Day 2: workshops + portfolio critique + forest walk. Day 3: small press roundtable + closing anthology reading. Speakers Section: 5 speaker profile cards, fictional names only. Include role and topic. Example: Mara Ellowen – essayist / “Writing With Weather”; Jules Ardent – book designer / “The Tactile Page”; Lina Vale – poet / “Moss, Memory, and Line Breaks”; Theo Bracken – editor / “Slow Publishing Futures”; Anika Reed – illustrator / “Botanical Image Systems”. Editorial Journal Section: static blog/article preview cards, no CMS. Articles: “How to Build a Field Notes Practice”, “Designing a Chapbook That Breathes”, “The Quiet Power of Seasonal Publishing”. Each has date, reading time, category. Chatbot Interaction Requirement: include a visible static front-end chatbot widget named “LeafBot”. It should look premium and friendly, like a small floating assistant card, but must work only with mock hardcoded responses / local front-end state. No AI API, no external chat service. Suggested UI: floating button bottom-right “Ask LeafBot”, opens a panel with starter chips: “What is the event?”, “Show schedule”, “Who should attend?”, “Tell me about portfolio reviews”. When user clicks or types, respond from a small predefined response map. Add note in tiny text: “Demo assistant uses static sample responses.” Make it polished, Apple-like, minimal, accessible. Ticket/Info Section: since no real commerce, create informational pricing-style cards only: Reader Pass, Writer Pass, Studio Pass. Buttons should say “Sample CTA” or “Request Info” and can scroll to contact section, no checkout. Include disclaimer: “Static preview only — no purchase flow.” Nature Design Details: subtle leaf line art, paper grain, translucent panels, botanical dividers, rounded 28px cards, large editorial serif headline paired with clean sans body. Motion: gentle fade-in, hover lift, smooth scroll, optional CSS-only floating animation. No 3D, no WebGL, no canvas, no game mechanics. Contact/Footer: static contact form visual only or simple mailto link. If form exists, it should not submit to backend, maybe show mock success message locally. Footer links: Program, Portfolio, Journal, Accessibility, Contact. Include newsletter mock block “Receive seasonal publishing notes” with static input and local demo message only. Responsiveness: must look excellent desktop/tablet/mobile. Mobile nav collapses nicely, cards stack, chatbot panel adapts to screen. Accessibility: semantic HTML, keyboard focus styles, good contrast, alt text placeholders, reduced motion consideration if possible. Deliverable: a polished static React website with all sections on one page, reusable components, clean CSS, no external API keys, no backend, no auth. Use mock content and local images/placeholders. Overall feeling: Apple keynote page meets literary nature festival meets boutique publishing portfolio.",
 "judge": {
  "model": "meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct-FP8",
  "model_sha": "94125d2bd83076b21eed33119525e29eaf3894f4",
  "request_model": "meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct-FP8:novita",
  "provider": "novita",
  "pinned_on": "2026-10-09",
  "temperature": 0,
  "max_tokens": 1024,
  "rubric_id": "rva1:mean(visual,query,asset)"
 }
}

"""Grade a Webdev task as the explorer does (verl recipes/design webdev-eval): render, shrink, judge.

No index.html in dist/ scores 0. A render that fails, or a judge that never answers, writes no reward (not scored):
neither says anything about the page."""
import base64
import io
import json
import os
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/tests")
os.environ["WEBDEV_GRADE_HTTP"] = "1"   # serve over loopback http so React/Vue/ES-module sites actually run
from webdev.eval_rubric import build_prompt  # noqa: E402
from webdev.shot import _build_shot_cmd, _parse_render_env, _parse_shot_b64  # noqa: E402
from webdev.verdict import parse_verdict  # noqa: E402

cfg = json.loads(Path("/tests/grade.json").read_text())
V = Path("/logs/verifier")
V.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
dist = Path(cfg["cwd"]) / "dist"


def done(reward: float | None, why: str, **extra) -> None:
    (V / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"reward": reward, "summary": why, **extra}, indent=1))
    print(why)
    if reward is None:
        print("not scored", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    (V / "reward.txt").write_text(f"{reward}\n")
    sys.exit(0)


files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(dist)) for p in dist.rglob("*") if p.is_file())[:200] if dist.is_dir() else []
if "index.html" not in files:
    done(0.0, "The agent delivered nothing to dist/." if not files else "dist/ has no index.html, so there is no page to open.",
         delivered=files)
res = subprocess.run(["sh", "-c", _build_shot_cmd(f"file://{dist}/index.html")], capture_output=True, text=True,
                     timeout=150)   # SHOT_TIMEOUT_S
shot = {"output": (res.stdout or "") + "\n" + (res.stderr or "")}
shot_b64, console_errors = _parse_shot_b64(shot)
render_env = _parse_render_env(shot)
if render_env.get("proxy_failed") or not shot_b64:
    print(shot["output"][-2000:], file=sys.stderr)
    done(None, "external assets were unreachable on every route" if render_env.get("proxy_failed")
         else "the screenshot produced no image")
jpg = base64.b64decode(shot_b64)
try:   # eval_mode._shrink: the judge refuses shots over 20 MP; proportional, quality 75
    from PIL import Image
    Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None
    im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(jpg))
    size = im.size
    if im.width * im.height > 20e6:
        k = (20e6 / (im.width * im.height)) ** 0.5
        im = im.convert("RGB").resize((max(1, int(im.width * k)), max(1, int(im.height * k))), Image.LANCZOS)
        b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, "JPEG", quality=75); jpg = b.getvalue(); size = im.size
except ImportError:
    size = None
(V / "screenshot.jpg").write_bytes(jpg)
content = [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(jpg).decode()}},
           {"type": "text", "text": build_prompt().format(query=cfg["query"][:1500])}]   # QUERY_CAP
url = os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_URL", "https://router.huggingface.co/v1").rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions"
_judge_pin = cfg["judge"]
if os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_REVISION") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
    done(None, "Judge deployment revision is unbound; not scored.")
(V / "judge_config.json").write_text(json.dumps(_judge_pin, indent=1))
body = json.dumps({"model": cfg["judge"]["request_model"], "temperature": 0, "max_tokens": 1024,  # webdev-temp0-pin@1
                   "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}]}).encode()
verdict, last = None, ""
for attempt in range(4):   # JUDGE_RETRIES, with eval_mode's backoff
    if attempt:
        time.sleep(min(60.0, 3.0 * (3 ** (attempt - 1))) * (0.5 + random.random()))
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method="POST", headers={
            "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('WEBDEV_JUDGE_KEY', '')}"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:   # JUDGE_TIMEOUT_S
            _judge_reply = json.loads(r.read())
            if _judge_reply.get("model_revision") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
                done(None, "Judge response revision differs from the task pin; not scored.")
            msg = _judge_reply["choices"][0]["message"]
        v = parse_verdict(msg.get("content") or msg.get("reasoning_content") or "")
        if "_failed" not in v:
            verdict = v
            break
        last = v["_failed"]
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        last = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:200]
if not verdict:
    done(None, f"judge unavailable: {last}")
done(verdict["score"], verdict.get("reason", ""), dims=verdict["dims"], visual=verdict["visual"], screenshot_size=size,
     console_errors=console_errors[:1500] if console_errors not in ("", "[]") else "")

rationale: Use temperature zero and bind the model/provider request and artifact revision; mask absent or mismatched deployment/response revision. Version-aware judge endpoint validation is staged.
